title: Levers
shortDefinition: A lever uses one segment of the opponent’s body to rotate or disrupt a larger structure.
whyItMatters: Levers let a smaller player off-balance, Kimura control, or arm drag without brute strength.
deepExplanation: An elbow separated from ribs, wrist across centerline, trapped Knee Line, or rotated shoulder line creates a lever. Reading levers lets you attack at the right moment.
beginnerView: Look for elbows or wrists separated from the body.
advancedView: Create levers through dilemmas instead of waiting for mistakes.
